content.title: The 2025 Boston Marathon is on April 21. Here's how to watch it on TV or stream it
content.text: April 17, 2025Updated April 18, 2025, 5:31 p.m. ETWatching the Boston Marathon live is a time-honored tradition. Whether you're cheering on runners at the start line in Hopkinton, kissing them at Wellesley's Scream Tunnel or waiting at the finish line near Copley Square, there's nothing like watching the Boston Marathon in person.But let's face it, some people aren't into the crowds. Or they don't like waking up especially early or they may be enjoying their April school break outside MetroWest.If you're in any of those categories, here's how you can watch the Marathon on Monday, April 21, from home or elsewhere:WCVB-TV has live coverage starting at 4 a.m.Live coverage of the Boston Marathon will exclusively air on WCVB-TV beginning at 4 a.m.The Marathon will be exclusively simulcast regionally on Hearst Television-owned sister stations WMUR (Manchester, New Hampshire), WMTW (Portland/Auburn, Maine) and WPTZ (Burlington, Vermont/Plattsburgh, New York).WCVB will also serve as the first exclusive broadcast partner for the Boston Athletic Association's Distance Medley races and will provide year-round coverage of the Boston Athletic Association and its races, with a focus on the Boston Marathon.Heading outside of New England for April break? Other TV stations have you covered.ESPN, in which Hearst holds a 20% interest, will feature Boston Marathon programing from 9:00 a.m. until 12:30 p.m. EST on ESPN2. ESPN will also have coverage of the race within SportsCenter before the live coverage and later that day, as well as coverage appearing on other ESPN shows and platforms.How you can stream the 2025 Boston MarathonWCVB-TV and its sister stations will also provide Marathon coverage on their digital platforms and mobile apps. The Marathon will be live-streamed on Very Local Boston, which hosts year-round content featuring the Boston Athletic Association.ESPN will cover the Marathon on its platforms as well.How to track your favorite runner in the Boston MarathonThe BAA Racing App will host the race's leader boards and unofficial results as runners cross the finish line. The BAA website will offer the ability to search for athletes during the race and view leaderboards in real time.2025 Boston Marathon: What's happening and whenMilitary March: 6 a.m.Men's Wheelchair: 9:06 a.m.Women's Wheelchair: 9:09 a.m.Handcycles and duos: 9:30 a.m.Professional Men: 9:37 a.m.Professional Women: 9:47 a.m.Para Athletics Division: 9:50 a.m.Wave 1: 10 a.m.Wave 2: 10:25 a.m.Wave 3: 10:50 a.m.Wave 4: 11:15 a.m.
